title: Chapter 1002 Building Blocks
content:
Chapter 1002 Building Blocks

Zhang Er, who was over sixty years old, had not slept for several days. Although he knew that this was a battle with no chance of winning, he still held his sword and did not bother to comb his messy hair, motivating the light knights to fight at the top of Puyang City.

"Qin wants to avenge Xihe and will massacre all the Wei people. We will undoubtedly die, but whether we die kneeling or standing depends on the second and third sons!"

Zhang Er not only wanted to show up himself, but also had Wei Bao be brought out, put on dazzling armor, and let him appear at the top of the city to inspire people.

However, Wei Bao has completely lost the complacency he had when he became King of Wei more than a year ago. His eyes are dull now and he only murmurs:

"Xu Fu lied to me, Xu Fu lied to me..."

If Xu Negation, a female fortune teller in Wen County, hadn't said that he would "have the spirit of an emperor" in the future, Wei Bao would not have come to sit on the throne of King Wei. Since he succeeded to the throne, he has been controlled by Zhang Er. After Zhang Er took Hedong, he was originally In order to divide the country and make Zhang Er the king of the Western Wei Dynasty, he went to Andong County. Unexpectedly, Zhang Er retreated all the way and returned to Dong County to squeeze with him.

Originally, Wei Bao thought that setting his capital in Puyang was a good sign, because it was called "Emperor Hill" in ancient times and was the former capital of Zhuan Xu. He could fulfill his orders here and revive the Wei Dynasty.

But who would have thought that this would be a dead end.

Fortune tellers tell fortunes many times every year. Those who make mistakes are forgotten, but those who are successful are remembered. This is how they gain the reputation of being able to calculate fortunes without fail.

Today, the King of Wei is discouraged, but the Prime Minister of Wei still persists.

But Zhang Er's fighting spirit almost collapsed the moment he learned about the death of his son Zhang Ao...

The head was hung on a horse and sent to the city. The Wei people sent warriors to drop it into a bamboo basket and go downstairs to retrieve it. The wet head actually belonged to Zhang Ao, Zhang Er's son...

The day before yesterday, Zhang Ao wanted to dig the mouth of the gourd and flood the river with the Qin army. Guan Ying, who had been on guard for a long time, took advantage of his plan and drove him into the water. He was hit by several arrows but survived. However, after he flopped ashore, he was attacked by several Dongjun knights. What was gained, the young knight of Dongjun now understood clearly. The Qin army at most killed them themselves, but Zhang Ao wanted to let hundreds of thousands of people in Dongjun bury themselves in the belly of fish. He hated it so much that he drowned him in the water and chopped them. He killed Zhang Ao's head and begged the Qin people to surrender.

Now Zhang Ao's head was sent to Puyang by Guan Ying to dampen the fighting spirit of the Wei army.

Holding his son's head in his arms, Zhang Er burst into tears.

The decision he made in Waihuang separated father and son. He thought that after reuniting, father and son could work together to do something great and even avenge the past. Unexpectedly, they were defeated and retreated all the way to Dongjun.

He hid under a pseudonym in Chen County because he knew that a man of great wisdom and courage would be able to tolerate small shame and small anger. His clouds are steaming and dragons are changing, and he wants to know something.

But in the end, it was all in vain.

Zhang Er murmured: "Why didn't I just die in the battle in Waihuang back then? What's the difference today?"

The Qin people's attack began again, and he was filled with grief and anger. Zhang Er stood up again and called on the light knights to join the battle. This time, he no longer commanded from a safe place, but took the lead, with his gray hair disheveled and holding a sword. Fight to the death with the Qin people who ascended the city.

"Kill Qin Kou!"

As if coming back to their senses, the Qin army's tidal offensive was repulsed again, and the Wei people cheered.

But they couldn't see clearly. On the man-made earth hill in the south of the city, a whole group of people were playing with a piece of equipment that was transported to the front line covered with cloth. The crossbow looked like a cart, with three composite bows, and the cart was turned on an axis (i.e. winch) to open the string and open the bow.

Even if the Wei people saw it, they would not be wary, because the Qin army's rhubarb crossbow, which has the longest range these days, can only shoot more than two hundred steps when used by two people, which is equivalent to the range of a trebuchet.

And that earth mountain is a full four hundred steps away from the city wall. There is no long-range weapon in the world that can reach this distance.

After a flurry of fuss, he finished aiming, and as the crossbowman clicked his teeth and fired the crossbow, there was a loud bang, and the arrow thundered and flew towards the city wall!

There were bursts of screams, but there was no time to escape.

This was originally a test shot. The Star Destroyer Crossbow was aimed at the left watchtower at the top of the city. Unexpectedly, it missed too far. By coincidence, it hit Zhang Er on the right side of the watchtower!

The arrow uses wood as the shaft and iron as the feather. The force cannot be underestimated. Before Zhang Er was conscious, his whole body was torn apart by the huge force. The shock was still on his face, but he was killed instantly!

…

After Zhang Er was killed, Puyang quickly lost its fighting spirit. After the Qin army captured Waiguo, Wei Bao chose to surrender.

As the horse entered Puyang City, Dongmen Bao saw the Wei flag trampled under the horse's hooves. Looking at the trembling front, Wei Bao was trembling, but because he couldn't find the sheep, he could only lead a dog instead. Wei Bao felt that This scene seems familiar!

He remembered that it was seventeen years ago. At that time, Hei Fu was just a small village leader, wandering around the village, and Dongmen Leopard was just a small leader. He was injured outside and returned to Chen Wu Jiu. He went to the Liangdi base camp to recuperate. Heifu and others escorted Waihuang's grain to Daliang before he rejoined the team.

But just as they were reminiscing about old times, Daliang City, which had been soaked for several months, suddenly collapsed!

Liang collapsed and Wei died. The group of them stood on tiptoe in the crowd, and finally saw that inside the open west gate of the beam, the last King of Wei was bound with his face naked, holding a sheep on the left and holding a straw on the right. He walked on his knees in the water, knelt all the way to the city gate, and surrendered to the Qin army...

General Wang Ben, on the other hand, proudly rode his horse into the beam.

Seventeen years have passed, and the young Shichang who was like a passer-by is now a dignified tiger prince, ranking among the nine ministers!

"Back then in Daliang, the pavilion chief and I were just spectators, watching Wang Ben's illustrious martial arts and enjoying the glory of destroying a country."

"And today, I feel like I was Wang Ben back then, doing what he did!"

Although they are enemies, Dongmen Leopard deeply admires Wang Ben, obeys his military skills, and respects his loyalty.

As loyal as Wang Ben was to Emperor Qin Shi Huang, Dongmen Bao must be as loyal to Duke Xia and his heirs!

The halberd in his hand raised the Wei flag high, and the Dongmen Leopard made the three armies shout in unison: "Xia Gong is victorious!"

He planned to sweep Dongjun and completely seize this place. He also sent Guan Ying with his chariots and cavalry to send the captured Wei Bao to Chenliu, together with the news of his victory.

"Go tell the regent"

"A Bao has fulfilled his mission and conquered Wei..."

He grinned and said, "I stepped back into the coffin!"

…

At the end of June, the month of summer, the sun is in the willows and the fire is dim.

The weather is hot, the willow trees beside the Honggou Bian River outside Chenliu City are shaded, and the cicadas are chirping.

This was the city that Heifu first attacked when he followed Wang Ben to destroy Wei seventeen years ago. Although there was no bloody battle at that time, that march had a profound impact on Heifu. It was at that time that he began to learn how to Marching and fighting.

Now the main force of the Qin army has successfully passed through Sanchuan and is firmly entrenched between Liang and Chu, and Chen Liu is the new headquarters selected by Heifu. This place is at the center of the world, with suburbs extending in all directions, bordered by the Hugou River and the Bianshui River, and controlling the Sui and Huaihe Rivers, which is enough to restrict Guandong.

What is placed in front of Heifu is a huge map of Kanto, with mountains, rivers and cities on it. Square building blocks are placed in different directions, each with the name of the Kanto princes.

"Chu, Zhao, Qi, Wei, Han, Dai, Yan... and the so-called 'King Zhao'."

When Heifudong left Hangu, he faced more than six enemies.

But now, there are only five left.

Just now, Heifu had picked up Dongfang's "Qi" building block, thrown it into the brazier behind him, and let it burn gradually.

Yesterday, Chen Ping reported that Peng Yue had led his remaining troops back to Xue County after the defeat in Pengcheng. This big bandit was also decisive. He immediately killed Tian Guang and imprisoned Kong Yu. He asked Hei Fu to surrender. He would also establish the Qi State and resist. The blame for the imperial court was thrown to the Lu and Confucians.

What’s funny is that the various quotations from the scriptures are written by Lu Ru at first glance...

It was easy for Peng Yue to escape as Prime Minister, but it was not easy for those who were already kings.

And just now, after receiving the good news from Dongmen Leopard from Puyang, Heifu also threw the "Wei" building block into it.

In addition to Qi Wei, there was also a block that had been burned to charcoal lying in the brazier.

The word originally written on it was: "Han"!

"regent."

Hei Fu turned around, but it was Chen Hui, his confidant from the Wing Camp. He bowed to Hei Fu and said:

"Zhang Liang, a Korean, has been escorted to Chenliu!"
